scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Shramik Seva Prasuti Sahayata Yojana
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered as an unorganized worker
Delivery must be in a government hospital
Applicant must not have already had two live births (maximum two live births allowed)
benefits_summary: Provides ₹4,000 during pregnancy and ₹12,000 for delivery in a government hospital, subject to prenatal check-ups and post‑birth conditions.
